a.title: Native read is the wait primitive. Bounded admission retains one native batch/raw suffix and a rejected CONTROL owner under pressure. Windows events are already decoded; POSIX input preserves arrival timestamps for streaming decoder deadlines.

CONTROL and DATA have separate budgets. scene.input may consume global input; otherwise EventRouter resolves focus/hit target and action, then delivers checked handlers. Equal Property values do not cause a new invalidation. A successful mutation receipt can still carry notification rejections.

renderReady returns while output is pending or cadence is not ready. With no dirty request it returns before preparation and painting. Idle still samples input and resize; it emits no periodic frame without invalidation. A late cycle does not cause catch-up frames.

Scene preparation synchronizes bindings and pins model revisions. Prepared views use final layout extents; a preparation-triggered layout invalidation can repeat the bounded pass. Provider request receipts are handled outside paint. Preparation starts no hidden provider worker.

Visible nodes paint through arranged surfaces and clips inside WidgetTree::frame. Renderer consumes borrowed commands into owning cells. A prepare/render failure ends the run with its original cause; the runner submits no partially built frame. Tree painting alone does not roll back earlier callback effects.

FrameWriter retains partial output and advances committed state only after complete consistent acceptance. An update can produce an empty diff. Any transport error ends this run; uncertain bytes are not reopened or replayed. Flush occurs at most once per cycle.

EOF finishes decoding, delivers admitted CONTROL and flushes submitted output. It does not wait for future frames, timers or DATA: a delivered edit may remain dirty and never be displayed. Cancellation can stop earlier. Native close depends on host/driver progress.
